QwenAssist v1.0.0

A hardened WebView wrapper for Qwen Chat (chat.qwen.ai).

Features: URL bar, settings dialog with toggles for HTTPS-only, domain whitelist, WebRTC, sensors, DNT, timezone spoofing (IANA-aware, DST-correct, full Date surface spoof via document_start injection), WebGL GPU spoofing, CPU/RAM spoofing (4/4), auto-hide arrow button, glassmorphism slide menu.

Note: X-Requested-With header cannot be stripped without breaking page loading (Android WebView limitation).

Based on testAssist / gptassist by @woheller69 and geminiAssist by @AcideFluorhydrique.
